usedFor: Lemon Squeezy holds subscriptions and customers, viaSocket utilities holds workflow controls, and “New Subscription Created” can start “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscription Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: It holds the workflow for a set number of minutes after a new subscription before later steps continue.

watchOut: “New Customer” and “New Discount” in Lemon Squeezy are polling, while “Subscription Cancelled” is pushed, so timing differs by trigger.
